newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates jump at end on high demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates jump at end on high demand.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates soared towards the end on Friday after wide fluctuations in early hours on high demand from borrowers, but are likely to remain stable on Saturday, dealers said.
"Early deals were conducted around 15 percent, but the rates slid later to 10 percent and a substantial amounts were exchanged around 12 percent," a dealer at KASB & Co said.
"Borrowers were unable to bring the rates down," he said. "The closing hour saw the rates rocketing back to 15 percent and then around 19 percent." -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
